## Items

1. **[CMRL→SR]** TN to issue GO and sign MoU with Southern Railway for CMRL takeover of MRTS; takeover within 90 days of MoU, 2-year transition; ₹6,600 crore "MRTS Rejuvenation" sought as Central sector project; targeted by Dec 2026. — The Hindu, Sep 30, https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/chennai/govt-to-soon-sign-mou-for-cmrls-takeover-of-mrts/article71528613.ece
2. **[CMRL]** Phase 2 first stretch Poonamallee Bypass–Vadapalani (14.64 km) opens Oct 11, inaugurated by PM Modi; 17 stations but only 11 open (6 skipped on Porur double-decker section); ₹40 max Vadapalani–Poonamallee Bypass, ₹50 to Airport/Egmore/Central; 15 trains at 10-min headway; driverless (UTO) only by mid-2027. — Times of India, Sep 30, https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/chennai-metro-phase-2-stretch-to-open-on-oct-11-trains-will-not-be-driverless-until-mid-2027/articleshow/134600807.cms
3. **[TNSTC/MTC]** "Vetri Payanam" zero-ticket expansion from Oct 2 (Gandhi Jayanti): women ride free on Deluxe, LSS & Express city buses, inter-district ordinary & hill buses >40 km; 12,692 buses across 7 corporations; ~84.32 lakh women daily. CM Vijay launches at Koyambedu & Ambattur. — News18 Tamil, Sep 30, https://tamil.news18.com/tamil-nadu/cm-vijay-launches-free-bus-travel-scheme-for-women-nw-kpk-ws-l-2220282.html
4. **[MTC]** E-tender for high-tension EV charging infrastructure: 3× 2,500 kVA 33kV/433V mega transformers at Avadi, Perambur & KK Nagar depots; EMD ₹1 lakh; bids close Nov 4. — Trinity Mirror, Sep 30, https://trinitymirror.net/mtc-gears-up-for-electric-buses (also Dinakaran Tamil: https://www.dinakaran.com/news/chennai-mtc-3-depots-mega-transformers-tender/amp)
5. **[SR]** ₹10.89 crore platform shelters at 10 suburban stations on Moore Market–Arakkonam section (Pattabiram, Pattabiram siding, Pattabiram E depot, Annanur, Veppampattu, Egattur, Pudlu, Kadambathur, Senji Panambakkam, Mosur); work started at Annanur & Pattabiram; part of 23-station upgrade. — Indian Express Tamil, Sep 30, https://tamil.indianexpress.com/tamilnadu/chennai-western-railway-stations-platform-shelters-renovation-10-89-crore-12593445
6. **[CMRL]** TBM "Marutham" breakthrough at Villivakkam Bus Terminus (Phase 2 Corridor 5, 47 km; 5.01 km UG section, twin-tunnel 3.94 km; 5 UG stations; Tata Projects). — CMRL official X, Oct 1, https://x.com/cmrlofficial/status/2105299456128057530
